references.title: BPR: Bayesian Personalized Ranking from Implicit Feedback

claims.text: BPR directly optimizes pairwise ordering preferences derived from implicit feedback rather than a pointwise classification objective.

references.title: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction

claims.text: DIN uses an attention-like activation unit to represent user interests adaptively with respect to the candidate item.

references.title: Entire Space Multi-Task Model: An Effective Approach for Estimating Post-Click Conversion Rate

claims.text: A multi-task architecture can transfer information through shared representations while optimizing related user-response objectives jointly.

references.title: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction

claims.text: DeepFM combines an FM component for low-order interactions with a neural component for higher-order interactions using shared feature embeddings.

references.title: Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations

claims.text: The ranking stage can optimize an expected-watch-time objective rather than relying only on click probability.

Training over a fixed window of logged data biases a model toward the past; an explicit example-age feature lets the model represent how item popularity varies with time rather than averaging over the window.

references.title: Recommendations as Treatments: Debiasing Learning and Evaluation

claims.text: Feedback logged under a non-uniform exposure policy yields systematically biased estimates of recommendation quality; unbiased estimates require accounting for the exposure mechanism, and data collected under randomized exposure provides such an unbiased sample.
